import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a 'fraud_status' column for clearer labeling in plots
df['fraud_status'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Not Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})

# Set a style for the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure with 3 subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(20, 6)) # Adjusted figsize for better readability

# Subplot 1: Distribution of 'amount' for fraudulent vs. non-fraudulent transactions
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='fraud_status', fill=True, common_norm=False, palette='viridis', ax=axes[0], linewidth=2)
axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='11', fontsize='10')

# Subplot 2: Fraud Rate by Hour of Day
# Calculate the mean fraud rate for each hour
fraud_rate_by_hour = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].mean().reset_index()
sns.lineplot(data=fraud_rate_by_hour, x='hour_of_day', y='is_fraud', marker='o', ax=axes[1], color='#e74c3c', linewidth=2) # Using a distinct color
axes[1].set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day (0-23)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (Proportion)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2)) # Show every 2 hours for clarity
axes[1].set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5) # Ensure full range is visible
axes[1].grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Subplot 3: Fraud Rate by Transaction Type
# Calculate the mean fraud rate for each transaction type and sort
fraud_rate_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).reset_index()
sns.barplot(data=fraud_rate_by_type, x='transaction_type', y='is_fraud', palette='magma', ax=axes[2]) # Using a sequential palette
axes[2].set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
axes[2].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (Proportion)', fontsize=12)
axes[2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
axes[2].tick_params(axis='y', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles/labels
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95]) # Adjust rect to make space for potential super title if needed

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
